items.stem: State the properties of Karl Pearson's coefficient of correlation. Explain why r is independent of change of origin and scale.
items.answer: Properties: no unit, lies between −1 and +1, sign shows direction, r = 0 means no linear relation, independent of change of origin and scale; subtracting a constant does not change deviations; dividing both by positive constants cancels in the formula.
